card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS headings before O-words
card.fires_on: Partway through words in ALL-CAPS label headings or boxed warnings, such as COMMUNITY, EXTENDED, FERRIC, CHRONIC, when the next word is likely to start with O.

modes.label: Split capitalized word before a hyphen
modes.description: Ending piece of a capitalized word like COMMUNITY or EXTENDED, before a hyphenated term.

modes.label: Word ending before an O-word
modes.description: The -IC ending of a capitalized adjective, followed by a capitalized word such as OBSTRUCTIVE.
modes.example: PATIENTS WITH CHRON<<IC>> OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY D

card.writes: It pushes the model toward next words that start with O and away from words that start with H.
card.plain: It fires inside capitalized heading words when the next word probably begins with the letter O.
